title: Fix Ctrl+Space not working in GTK programs
summary: Force GNOME settings to use Fcitx as the input module if Ctrl+Space fails to activate it in GTK applications.

aliases.text: ctrl space не работает в gtk

steps.explain: Set the GNOME settings override to explicitly use Fcitx as the GTK input module.
steps.expect: No output, but Ctrl+Space should now work in GTK applications like gnome-terminal.
